verdict.rationale: The only evidence of background automation is a help-center index entry listing 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among Kimi's general features, plus agent-mode/Agent-cluster topics. The Kimi Code docs describe autonomous task completion, but only within interactive terminal or desktop sessions, not unattended background runs. Missing for 10: documented setup of scheduled or triggered automations, evidence they run unattended in the background, details on limits and outputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
